record.question: The other judge gave his note of _________.
record.explanation: Answer B: dissent. “Note of dissent” is the standard phrase: dissent means disagreement with a decision or opinion. Independent check: A “note of dissent” is a formal expression of disagreement, the standard collocation in the sentence. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/outlaw; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/dissent. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
